description: Letter in Judaeo-Arabic. Large fragment. Mentions: receipt of the addressee's letter; news of a terrible thing (akhbār al-ʿaẓīma); something from the recipients student in his handwriting (min tilmīdhika bi-khaṭṭihi); something that will lead to corruption (fasād); an admonishment that the addressee should have written about something; greetings to Abū l-Faraj b. Shuwayʿ and to a ḥaver.
